input.command:
timeout 40 npx wrangler dev --no-bundle --local 2>&1 &
WRANGLER_PID=$!
sleep 8
echo "=== GET /api/agents ===" && curl -s http://localhost:8787/api/agents | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'count={len(d)} agents')" 2>/dev/null || curl -s http://localhost:8787/api/agents | head -200
echo ""
echo "=== GET /api/companies/9a7cf1f3-02a7-4751-9cdb-671c9c68edb5 ===" && curl -s "http://localhost:8787/api/companies/9a7cf1f3-02a7-4751-9cdb-671c9c68edb5" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('name','?'), d.get('status','?'))" 2>/dev/null
echo ""
echo "=== GET /api/issues ===" && curl -s "http://localhost:8787/api/issues?companyId=9a7cf1f3-02a7-4751-9cdb-671c9c68edb5" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'count={len(d) if isinstance(d,list) else \"err\"} items')" 2>/dev/null || curl -s "http://localhost:8787/api/issues" | head -100
kill $WRANGLER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $WRANGLER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
input.description: Test agents, company by ID, and issues routes
